meta.name: basic-syntax
meta.description: If-else formatting, spacing, function parameters, and conditional rendering rules for the Trezor Suite codebase. Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript/React code.

copy.tagline: 按 Trezor Suite 规范格式化 TypeScript/React 代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 Trezor Suite 项目中写或审查 TypeScript/React 代码
copy.tagline_en: Format TypeScript/React code per Trezor Suite conventions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write or review TypeScript/React code in the Trezor Suite project

howto.what: Claude 会按照 Trezor Suite 的语法规范格式化代码：if-else 必须用花括号（单行无 else 可省略）、用空行分隔逻辑、参数超过两个用对象传参、JSX 条件确保是布尔值。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或审查 TypeScript/React 代码时触发。

say.text: 请用 basic-syntax 规则格式化这段 TypeScript 代码。
say.note: Claude 会调整代码结构符合规范。

say.text: 检查这个 if-else 块是否符合 Trezor Suite 规范。
say.note: Claude 会指出不合规之处。

say.text: 将函数参数改为对象形式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows Trezor Suite coding conventions: if-else with braces (except single-line without else), use blank lines to group logic, use object parameters for more than two args, and ensure JSX conditions are booleans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing or reviewing TypeScript/React code.

say_en.text: Format this TypeScript code using basic-syntax rules.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust code structure accordingly.

say_en.text: Check if this if-else meets Trezor Suite standards.
Refactor function parameters into an object.
